# The entropy floor of a regenerative event record

29 October 2026, Brisbane. Root construction. This is a variational
characterization in an explicit record topology, not an exact-record
optimizer or a physical thermal device.

## 1. Record and physical scope

B is a finite set of resolved singleton microscopic ports, all fixed
by physical reversal. K_ij(t) is the stationary FLUX density of a hidden
excursion from port i to its next port j, with positive interior duration
t. Native initial port holds are separate. Direct flux d_ij, i!=j, is
also separate; d_ii=0. Let F_ij=integral K_ij and rho_i=sum_j(F_ij+d_ij).
Assume port row and column flux sums agree and the trace is irreducible.
Assume R>0 whenever using per-departure or mean-cycle quantities; the
event-free singleton case has E=J=V=0 and is treated separately.
Supplied positive port weights w_i fix native holding rates rho_i/w_i.
Let V=sum_ij integral t K_ij(t)dt be finite, W=sum_i w_i+V, R=sum_i rho_i.

The observed event-flux reversal divergence is

    J(K,d)=sum_ij integral K_ij(t)log[K_ij(t)/K_ji(t)]dt
                      +sum_i!=j d_ij log(d_ij/d_ji).       (1)

Assume J is finite. Supports are therefore reciprocal up to null sets.

fixing B, define its intrinsic stationary reversal-divergence rate by

where lambda_x=-q_xx. Then sigma=E/W is the long-horizon path KL rate.
The fixed-horizon stationary path KL also has boundary D(pi||pi Theta).

faithful physical reversal and local detailed balance. The prior all-even
and midpoint-operation theorems keep their own assumptions unchanged.

# Exact finite attainment of the native entropy floor

29 October 2026. Independent continuation of root's entropy-completion
converse. This establishes a finite-record criterion alongside the closure
theorem. A comprehensive priority search for this classification is not
complete. Its ingredients are phase-type reversal, exponential tilting,
and equality in relative-entropy data processing.

## 1. The criterion

Assume the finite native port setup of the independent review: positive
port weights, fixed holding clocks, balanced irreducible port traffic,
reciprocal direct support, and finite observed event divergence J. Every
nonzero positive-duration pair density K_ij is assumed phase-type after
normalization. This holds whenever the target record comes from a finite
CTMC; the conditioning argument is given below.

**Theorem.** There exists an exact finite CTMC completion, with arbitrary
hidden parity fixing the ports, that attains intrinsic E=J if and only if
for every nonzero off-diagonal pair there are constants C_ij>0 and real
delta_ij such that

    K_ij(t)/K_ji(t)=C_ij exp(delta_ij t),  t>0.              (1)

The completion preserves all port weights, direct fluxes, endpoint flux
masses, holding rates, and total hidden mass/mean. Its hidden state count
and rates are finite but otherwise unconstrained. The reverse constants
are C_ji=1/C_ij and delta_ji=-delta_ij. Self-return pairs have ratio one
and need no additional condition.

This is exact attainment by one finite model. It does not classify the
infimum over models that reproduce a fixed record exactly when (1) fails.
That infimum need not be attained and can even be infinite, as in root's
one-phase/two-phase example. The weighted-L1 closure floor remains J.

Let mu be the complete microscopic excursion-flux measure and mu^R its
parity reversal. E=D_flux(mu||mu^R) and J is its image divergence under

## Native record and exact matching

6. The native entropy floor assumes resolved singleton microscopic ports
   fixed under reversal. A return to a coarse symbol need not reset hidden
   orientation. The fourfold completion is inadmissible at the resolved
   singleton interface and therefore does not erase its J floor.
7. Histogram Erlang components overlap. Their microscopic component KL is
   generally larger than their observed duration KL. Exact common-mixture
   representation alone does not prove exact entropy attainment.
8. Narrowing Erlangs at fixed bin centers does not prove L1 convergence.
   The root construction refines log bins faster than kernel narrowing and
   proves convergence in L1 weighted by 1+t, preserving the total mean.
9. Exact finite attainment for phase-type records is iff every directional
   ratio is C exp(delta t). With equal reversed escape clocks, delta=0.
   The reverse PH occupation vector is beta_minus(-T_minus)^-1, generally
   not the tempting z*h/C formula.
10. The exact-record infimum when this attainment criterion fails remains
    unclassified in general. The one-phase/two-phase example has infinite
    exact finite cost but finite closure floor. Exact short-time zeros are
    additional structural information, not a conclusion from finite samples.
11. Native flux E, entropy per departure E/R, and per-time sigma=E/W are
    distinct normalizations. R>0 is assumed for departure/cycle quantities;
    an event-free singleton is handled separately.
